+# RAG-LITE-HVY-00 Boundary Readback
+
+Generated: 2026-07-06
+
+Issue: #1374
+
+Parent: #1361
+
+Upstream semantic parent: #1360
+
+Current `origin/main` SHA at preflight: `fe65a4690760707870c8c0dcda33f3463a13f534`
+
+## Scope
+
+This readback freezes the RAG-LITE boundary from the SEM-KG handoff before real answer-packet pilots begin.
+
+#1374 depends only on the parent boundary issues #1360 and #1361. #1374 can complete before #1367 or #1369 produce a non-empty accepted/provisional semantic slice. This issue must not consume an empty, raw-candidate-only, review-only, rejected, or blocked semantic layer as if it were RAG input.
+
+#1375 is different: #1375 cannot validate real RAG input until #1367 or #1369 produces a non-empty accepted/provisional manifest that separates accepted facts from provisional downgraded context.
+
+## Parent Boundary Summary
+
+#1360 defines the SEM-KG-CODEX-HVY production path. It may produce Codex-authored semantic assertions, but Codex-authored assertions remain model judgments until deterministic validation and promotion gates decide their status. Raw candidates, review_required assertions, rejected assertions, and blocked_quarantined assertions must not enter runtime or RAG answer facts.
+
+#1361 defines RAG-LITE-HVY as a no-mutation, posture-aware consumption lane. RAG-LITE can use accepted semantic assertions as facts and provisional_safe assertions only with visible downgrade/posture labeling. It must exclude raw_candidate, review_required, rejected, and blocked_quarantined assertions from answer facts. If semantic KG is absent, degraded, or candidate-only, `EvidenceContextPack` must mark semantic context as `unavailable` or `degraded` and fall back to question text, runtime evidence, Method/Procedure posture, and other verified evidence.
+
+## Prior SEM-KG Handoff Evidence
+

+
